visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera pans across a light-colored, speckled tabletop, revealing an Apple Mac Studio in the background and a larger Mac mini in the foreground. A person's hand enters from the right, pointing a finger directly at the top surface of the Mac mini. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a studio setting. (2) The camera moves slightly to adjust the framing, focusing on the size comparison between the two devices. The hand continues to gesture towards the older Mac mini, highlighting its larger footprint compared to the compact Mac Studio sitting behind it. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom center of the frame. (3) The shot cuts to a tighter angle of the two products, emphasizing the sleek aluminum finish and the black Apple logos on top. The hand remains in the frame, used for scale, as the camera emphasizes the height and width differences. The background shows a computer monitor's base and a dark gray mat.
